name: Iterative Bisection for Zero-Crossing
definition: A method to find the point where the SDF assumes the isovalue c = 0 along an edge exhibiting a material change, reduced to finding a value t ∈ [0,1] representing the relative intersection point.
summary: Iterative Bisection for Zero-Crossing finds SDF boundaries using numerical approximation rather than linear interpolation, handling non-linear variations at higher computational cost.
